title: Fred Crisman and Hunt as the Dallas tramps
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Fred Crisman and Hunt as the Dallas tramps, about 1963 at Texas (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I can corroborate. In fact, he wasn't the only one. I mean, Eh Howard Hunt might have been one of them as well.

There's a guy named Fred Chrisman, who they think was one of the three hobos who was arrested uh after the after the shooting of JFK. He was also involved in the Mory Island incident in 1947, right around Kenneth Arnold seeing his UFO.
tellings.difference: Links Crisman to the 1947 Maury Island incident and Kenneth Arnold's sighting, and does not mention E. Howard Hunt.
tellings.link_reason: Both claim Fred Crisman was one of the three tramps arrested in Dallas after the JFK shooting. This telling also mentions his part in Maury Island only as background.

as_told.title: Fred Crisman, JFK 'three tramps' and the Maury Island incident
